required.quote: Proof of compliance with all of the requirements established by the Board for continuing education for the renewal of the certificate of registration

hours_per_period.quote: require each architect, registered interior designer or residential designer who holds a certificate of registration pursuant to the provisions of this chapter to complete not more than 12 hours per year of continuing education as a condition to the renewal of the certificate

period_years.quote: not more than 12 hours per year of continuing education as a condition to the renewal of the certificate

available.quote: The Board may, in lieu of all examinations for a certificate of registration to practice architecture or residential design, accept satisfactory evidence of registration as an architect in another jurisdiction where the qualifications required are equal to those required in this chapter

requirements.value: Board may accept satisfactory evidence of registration as an architect in another jurisdiction where qualifications are equal to those required in Nevada. Board may require NCARB certificate as satisfactory evidence.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may practice: (a) Architecture or use the title of architect ... in this State without having a certificate of registration issued to him or her pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: the Board shall issue to the successful applicant a certificate as a registered architect

is_mandatory.quote: No person may practice: (a) Architecture or use the title of architect ... in this State without having a certificate of registration issued to him or her pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No person may practice: (a) Architecture or use the title of architect ... in this State without having a certificate of registration issued to him or her pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Engage in the practice of architecture or residential design or practice as a registered interior designer without a certificate of registration issued by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate was obtained by fraud or concealment of a material fact.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The certificate was obtained by fraud or concealment of a material fact.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder found guilty of fraud, deceit, or concealment of a material fact in professional practice, or convicted of a crime involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the certificate has been found guilty by the Board or found guilty or guilty but mentally ill by a court of justice of any fraud, deceit or concealment of a material fact in his or her professional practice, or has been convicted by a court of justice of a crime involving moral turpitude.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder found guilty of incompetency, negligence, or gross negligence in the practice of architecture or residential design.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the certificate has been found guilty by the Board of incompetency, negligence or gross negligence in: (1) The practice of architecture or residential design

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder affixed signature or seal to plans not prepared by or under responsible control of the holder, or permitted use of name to assist unregistered persons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of a certificate has affixed his or her signature or seal to plans, drawings, specifications or other instruments of service which have not been prepared by the holder of the certificate or in his or her office, or under his or her responsible control, or has permitted the use of his or her name to assist any person who is not a registered architect, registered interior designer or residential designer to evade any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder aided or abetted any unauthorized person to practice architecture or residential design.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of a certificate has aided or abetted any unauthorized person to practice: (1) Architecture or residential design

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder violated any law, regulation, or code of ethics pertaining to the practice of architecture or residential design.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of the certificate has violated any law, regulation or code of ethics pertaining to: (1) The practice of architecture or residential design

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holder failed to comply with a Board order or failed to cooperate with a Board investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder of a certificate has failed to comply with an order issued by the Board or has failed to cooperate with an investigation conducted by the Board.

definition_quote.value: The "practice of architecture" consists of rendering services embracing the scientific, esthetic and orderly coordination of processes which enter into the production of a completed structure which has as its principal purpose human habitation or occupancy, or the utilization of space within and surrounding the structure, performed through the medium of plans, specifications, administration of construction, preliminary studies, consultations, evaluations, investigations, contract documents and advice and direction.
definition_quote.quote: The "practice of architecture" consists of rendering services embracing the scientific, esthetic and orderly coordination of processes which enter into the production of a completed structure which has as its principal purpose human habitation or occupancy, or the utilization of space within and surrounding the structure, performed through the medium of plans, specifications, administration of construction, preliminary studies, consultations, evaluations, investigations, contract documents and advice and direction.

methods_authorized.quote: performed through the medium of plans, specifications, administration of construction, preliminary studies, consultations, evaluations, investigations, contract documents and advice and direction

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: "Registered interior designer" means a person who provides some or all of the services set forth in NRS 623.0225 and holds a certificate of registration issued by the Board pursuant to subsection 2 of NRS 623.180.

interior_design_services_defined.quote: "Practice as a registered interior designer" means the rendering, by a person registered pursuant to subsection 2 of NRS 623.180, of services to enhance the quality and function of an interior area of a structure designed for human habitation or occupancy.

permitted_firm_structures.quote: Architects, registered interior designers, residential designers, professional engineers and landscape architects may join or form a partnership, corporation, limited-liability company or other business organization or association

firm_design_professional_ownership_minim.quote: control and two-thirds ownership of the business organization or association is held by persons registered or licensed in this State pursuant to the applicable provisions of this chapter, chapter 623A or 625 of NRS

seal_required.quote: Upon being issued a certificate of registration, each registered architect, registered interior designer or residential designer shall obtain a seal of the design authorized by the Board

seal_surrender_required_on_license_termi.quote: It is unlawful for a person to stamp or seal any plan, specification, report or other document with the seal after the certificate of registration of the architect, registered interior designer or residential designer, named therein, has expired or has been suspended or revoked

value: Buildings owned by person or employer when architect or licensed professional engineer is also engaged
exempt_building_types.quote: Any person who prepares plans, drawings or specifications for: (1) Buildings for his or her own private residential use; (2) Farm or ranch buildings used as such; or (3) Buildings owned by that person or his or her employer when an architect, a registered interior designer, a residential designer or a licensed professional engineer is also engaged

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: The Board may require, as satisfactory evidence of that registration, a certificate of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: The Board may adopt the standards of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards, and the examination and grading procedure of that organization, as they exist on the date of adoption.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.value: Misdemeanor; fine of not less than $500 nor more than $1,000, and may be further punished by imprisonment in the county jail for not more than 6 months.
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: For the first violation, is guilty of a misdemeanor and shall be punished by a fine of not less than $500 nor more than $1,000, and may be further punished by imprisonment in the county jail for not more than 6 months.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.value: Gross misdemeanor; fine of not less than $1,000 nor more than $2,000, and may be further punished by imprisonment in the county jail for not more than 364 days.
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_s.quote: For the second or any subsequent violation, is guilty of a gross misdemeanor and shall be punished by a fine of not less than $1,000 nor more than $2,000, and may be further punished by imprisonment in the county jail for not more than 364 days.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: a person who violates any provision of this chapter or any regulation adopted by the Board is subject to a civil penalty of not more than $10,000 for each violation
